description: Hello, I am a 14 year old student at Dublin and I created a game that shows the things left behind in space.
summary: I developed a game that helps shed more light on the abandoned artifacts left in space. It is interactive and easy to use for people of all ages. It allows the user to learn about each site, and is then asked questions about each one after.
details: The project was created using JavaScript on VS Code. It is a game in which the user can move around to the sites of abandoned artifacts in space and learn more about them. The project was also refined using Google Antigravity
dataRefs: List of NASA's Abandoned Equipment Sites
